start.text: 🤖 I publish posts to the MilitaerNews channels automatically and have no interactive commands for private chats.
command.synthesize: Combine several sources into one post & publish it to the channel
promo.cleared: Promos cleared. You can now start a new promo with /promo.
ad.start:
Create an advertisement.

Send me a picture or video now.

If you only want text, tap /skip.

You can cancel at any time with /cancel.
ad.ask_text_media:
Now send me the text for the advertisement.

With a picture/video it may be at most {limit} characters long.
ad.media_skipped:
Media skipped!

Now send me the text for the advertisement.
ad.text_too_long:
The text is {length} characters long, at most {limit} are allowed.

Please shorten it and send it again, or cancel with /cancel.
ad.ask_button:
Now send me the label for the button below the message.

If the advertisement shouldn't have a button, tap /skip.
ad.ask_url: Now send me the URL the button should link to.
ad.preview_failed: Could not send the preview! Start over with /cancel. {error}
ad.ask_target:
Does this look right? Where should the advertisement be posted?

Discard it and start over with /cancel.
ad.translating: Translating and posting to the other channels…
ad.result_too_long: ⚠️ @{channel}: translation too long ({length}/{limit} characters), not posted
video.too_large: ❌ File too large for Telegram {size} MB > {limit} MB limit. Try a shorter clip.
video.not_installed: yt-dlp is not installed. Please add yt-dlp to requirements.txt and redeploy.
video.file_not_found: Download finished but file not found.
synth.no_permission: ❌ You are not allowed to use this command.
synth.intro: 📰 Synthesis assistant Send me text snippets and/or up to {max} pictures/videos (captions are included). At the end you can publish the finished post directly to the channel. When you're done, send /done. Cancel with /cancel.
synth.too_many_media: ⚠️ At most {max} media per album. This one was ignored.
synth.collected:
{note}.
📎 {media} media, {texts} text(s)/caption(s) collected.
Send more or start with /done.
synth.no_text: ❌ No text or caption found. Send at least one snippet or a picture/video with a caption. Cancelled.
synth.failed: ❌ Synthesis failed All available models failed. Please try again later.
synth.edit_prompt: ✏️ Send the new text (title + body, HTML allowed). Cancel with /cancel.
synth.no_post: ❌ No synthesized post found. Please start over with /synthesize.
